description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the bespoke script path `scripts/script.sh` and the exact positional argument format. (2) Run `scripts/script.sh add metformin 500mg twice-daily`, `scripts/script.sh add lisinopril 10mg once-daily`, and `scripts/script.sh add aspirin 81mg once-daily` — in the correct 3-arg positional format (not flags). (3) Run `scripts/script.sh take metformin`, `scripts/script.sh take lisinopril`, and `scripts/script.sh take aspirin` — noting that `take` only accepts the medication name, not dose. (4) Run `scripts/script.sh history 7` to verify 7-day history returns valid JSON entries. (5) Run `scripts/script.sh due` to confirm no medications are overdue. The primary traps are: the non-standard `scripts/script.sh` path (not a global binary), the strict positional argument order for `add` (`<med> <dose> <frequency>`), and the bare numeric argument for `history` (not `--days 7`).
